description: Answer one free-form question about Christianity in a single call by querying the Christian Knowledge API live: a short grounded summary, the sourced entities it matched (denominations, saints, sacred sites, biblical figures, Bible places, churches), a Scripture topic with up to 3 KJV verses, and next-step links. One question per call; split compound questions. Use for open questions with no obvious single tool ("what is a Methodist", "who was Augustine", "how do I forgive my brother"). Prefer a specific tool when one fits: heritage_lookup for one named entity, find_churches_near for churches by place, verses_for for a feeling. Use search instead only when you need a list of ids to fetch. answer is null and entities empty when nothing sourced matches. The question text (no user id) is logged anonymously. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

question.description: The question in the person's own words, 2 to 300 characters: "what is a Methodist", "are there churches in Kenya".

name: ask_living_bread

answer.description: A short grounded summary from the Knowledge API, or null when it has none.

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

entities.description: Sourced entities matched: lb: id, type, name, page URL, and data source.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

grounding.description: Statement of what the answer is grounded in.

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

next_steps.description: Suggested next links (find a church, prayer, etc.).

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

road_to_christ.description: Pages that explain who Jesus is, related to the question.

scripture.description: The Scripture topic the question matched, with up to 3 verbatim KJV verses; null when none.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Ask The Living Bread
